name: Trizhdy nozhom
source:
Spend the night with a girl on the roof of a dormitory, waiting out the rain and listening to the stories of a red-haired guitarist.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3822719729]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在宿舍天台上与一名少女共度良宵，一边等待大雨停歇，一边静静倾听红发吉他手娓娓道来的故事。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3822719729]Steam[/url]]
